sentences.text: Mr. Binoy Kumar Panda, Ms. Sima Biswas. ... for the State.
IA NO: CRAN 1 of 2023 Learned advocate appearing on behalf of the appellant appears and application for condonation of delay has been served upon the State.
The application under Section 5 for condonation of delay is taken up for hearing.
It appears that there is delay of 74 days in filing appeal.
Delay has duly been explained in the application itself.

Accordingly IA NO: CRAN 1 of 2023 stands disposed of.
CRA (SB) 102 of 2023 It is submitted on behalf of the appellant that prima facie case Akshay Singh and the appellant, Rohit Pandey were found guilty committing offence under Section 366 of the IPC only though the case was initially started under Section 365/366 and 376 (2) (i).
Considering all facts and circumstances the appeal is admitted.
Trial Court Record be called for.
After arrival of the Lower Court Record, if it is found, otherwise in order, the formal paper book shall be prepared within six weeks thereafter.
Liberty is given to file bail application.
Realization of fine amount be stayed in the meantime.

(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
